description: Find Arizona Revised Statutes sections BY TOPIC when you do not have a citation: "use tax exemption solar energy devices", "landlord security deposit", "driving under the influence". Searches the full text of Arizona state law, then ranks sections by how well their own catchline fits the query. Returns candidate citations with catchlines (the answer is usually one of the first few); call az_revised_statute with a citation for the statutory text. Optional title filter (e.g. 42 for Taxation). Returns found:false with a reason on a miss, never an empty list. Keyless.

examples.query: use tax exemption solar energy devices

query.description: Topic or keywords in plain English, e.g. "use tax exemption solar energy devices".

title.description: Optional: restrict to one ARS title number, e.g. "42" (Taxation), "13" (Criminal Code), "33" (Property).

name: az_search

data_as_of.description: ISO timestamp of the upstream read

found.description: true when at least one section matched; false with reason no_match on a miss

catchline_terms_matched.description: How many query words appear in the catchline

phrase_hits.description: Upstream phrase-hit count for this section

terms_searched.description: Query words sent upstream after filler words were removed

total_matched.description: Number of sections the Legislature full-text search matched before ranking

title: Az Search
